scientific_summary: Perceptual autoencoding learns a spatial latent space separately from generative diffusion. A time-conditional U-Net denoises in that lower-dimensional space; cross-attention supplies conditional control; decoding is one pass.
invariants: Compression is learned before diffusion; latent space is fixed during generative learning.
Condition encoder and denoiser are jointly optimized; do not mark the condition encoder frozen.
Forward noising is fixed and training-only; synthesis begins from Gaussian latent noise.
Keep actual latent spatial grids, not a one-dimensional token vector.
A shared decoder reconstructs encoded inputs and decodes generated latent samples in one pass.
Q derives from U-Net spatial features; K,V derive from encoded condition. No full attention formula needed.
The input photograph is a real NASA image used only as an illustrative input. All reconstructed/generated outputs and latent imagery are schematic illustrations, not actual model results.
Do not redraw the selected photo; its declared square slot remains clean for deterministic embedding.
layout: Titles are bold dark text directly on white or ordinary panel background: NO coloured title ribbons, tabs, header bars, white reversed headings, or whole-figure banner. Soft colour highlights only meaningful interior content and the key mechanism; avoid a repeated card-header grid. Use a clear matched family of moderately bold, slightly hand-drawn shaft arrows with solid readable triangular heads and palette-matched ink. Keep planned endpoints and exact centerlines; all shafts continuous beside text, including across model titles. Equal peer regions and clean rectangular outer silhouette remain. Latent Diffusion, one bounded rectangular 1700×1150 overview. Six equal-width columns. Two matched-height scientific lanes titled Perceptual Compression and Latent Generation, both centered horizontally in dedicated header bands clear of all shafts. Short middle conditioning strip. Shared decoder one spanning column, denoising two columns. Reserve a clean 150×150 white photo slot inside input image frame at [75,195,150,150], below RGB Image x and above the short NASA / Apollo 17 credit. The actual selected Earth photo is pasted after generation; DO NOT draw anything in that one slot, not even placeholder words. Upper/lower output images are schematic Earth disks, explicitly labelled Schematic, not real model results. No other empty inset. Local model geometry remains native; every source-border to target arrow is continuous and aligned.
typography: Arial or a coherent clean sans serif. Bold black/dark headings on unpainted background; scientific interior fill only. Short readable labels, no gray microcopy, no visible underscore, mathematical indices genuinely typeset. Reserve labels away from shafts.
